name: chief financial officer
normative-structure: The books are this office's record: what the firm has, what it owes, what value each unit created and captured, and in what denomination any of that is counted. It persists across incumbents because the investment review board's own allocations are meaningless without it — a board that says 'continue at this scale' with no currency to state the scale in has decided nothing checkable. So the office settles what an allocation is denominated in, keeps the accounts in that denomination, and answers for the books matching what actually happened rather than what a unit reported about itself.
theory-basis: rendanheyi/gongying-zengzhi-biao: the win-win value-added statement replaces the P&L with an account of user resources, ecosystem parties, and value-added sharing — line items with no counterpart in conventional accounts, per lib/emsenn/services/561-group/services/coesite-clearing/services/union-officer-academy/services/management-thought/rendanheyi/content/glossary/terms/gongying-zengzhi-biao.md

rendanheyi/zengzhi-fenxiang: value-added sharing divides surplus above a committed target among every party to a chain-group contract, symmetric with shortfall — the books must carry this pool separately from ordinary pay
rendanheyi/ren-dan-chou: pay is a function of user value created and falls to zero when none is created — a rule the books must be able to compute against, not merely assert
huidu-guanli: 账实相符 — accounts must match reality; an office that books what a unit reports rather than what happened has stopped being an office and become a scribe for the unit's own claim

emsenn/office/investment-review-board (unrealized): 'no allocation currency is defined: the firm budgets attention rather than money' — settling that denomination and keeping the ledger the board's allocations spend from is this office's work
unrealized: Historical source finding of 2026-10-02 (unverified as a current live service): the books substrate exists: keep-the-books.js can seat sourced unit-value entries and a canonical win-win value ledger is present; observed current coverage remains effectively unpopulated and no firm-wide allocation denomination has been settled

Historical source finding of 2026-10-02 (unverified as a current live service): no populated decision-grade win-win value-added statement was observed for an operating unit, so value created and value captured are not yet legible across the current portfolio

Historical source finding of 2026-10-02 (unverified as a current live service): no conventional monetary journal currently carries sourced receipts, fees, payouts, provider expenses, reimbursements, founder contributions, or seller-to-realizer transfers; conventional money must remain separate from the group-value ledger
nothing yet computes ren-dan-chou for any micro-enterprise, so pay from user value is a rule stated in theory and not yet a number this office can produce
